name: ghita-coding-agent
description: GHITA CODING AGENT - Desktop AI Agent với multi-provider, skills, computer use
author: ghitatruongle

scripts.build: node scripts/fix-store.mjs && pnpm install && turbo build --filter=./packages/* --filter=./apps/desktop --filter=./apps/vscode-extension && pnpm --filter @ghita/mobile build
scripts.clean:all: turbo clean && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf packages/*/node_modules && rm -rf apps/*/node_modules
scripts.rebuild: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/node_modules && pnpm install && turbo build --filter=./packages/* --filter=./apps/desktop --filter=./apps/vscode-extension --force && pnpm --filter @ghita/mobile build
